PUNJ 100.title: Introductory Punjabi I
PUNJ 100.description: Spoken and written Punjabi. Students who have taken Punjabi 11 in high school cannot take PUNJ 100 for credit.

PUNJ 101.title: Introductory Punjabi II
PUNJ 101.description: Continuation of PUNJ 100. Students who have taken Punjabi 11 in high school cannot take PUNJ 101 for credit. Recommended pre-requisite: PUNJ 100.

PUNJ 102.title: Introductory Punjabi
PUNJ 102.description: Spoken and written Punjabi. As of 2011W, Students who have taken Punjabi 11 in high school cannot take PUNJ 102 for credit.

PUNJ 200.title: Intermediate Punjabi
PUNJ 200.description: Study of the grammar and introduction to Punjabi literature. As of 2011W, Recommended pre-requisites: one of PUNJ 101, PUNJ 102.

PUNJ 201.title: Intermediate Punjabi I
PUNJ 201.description: Study of the grammar and introduction to Punjabi literature. Recommended pre-requisite: PUNJ 101.

PUNJ 202.title: Intermediate Punjabi II
PUNJ 202.description: Continuation of PUNJ 201. Recommended pre-requisite: PUNJ 201.

PUNJ 205.title: Introduction to the Gurmukhi Script
PUNJ 205.description: The writing system of Punjabi for those with some background in the spoken language. May be taken at the same time as PUNJ 200.

PUNJ 300.title: Advanced Punjabi
PUNJ 300.description: Advanced grammar and conversation. Major genres of Punjabi literature. As of 2011W, Recommended pre-requisites: one of PUNJ 200, PUNJ 202.

PUNJ 401.title: Devotional Literature in Punjabi
PUNJ 401.description: Emphasis is on reading and written expression. Analytical writing in English and Punjabi required. Recommended pre-requisite: PUNJ 300.

PUNJ 402.title: Waris Shah's Hir
PUNJ 402.description: A detailed study of Waris Shah's poetic narration of the story of Hir. Emphasis is on reading and written expression. Analytical writing in English and Punjabi required. Recommended pre-requisite: PUNJ 300.

PUNJ 403.title: Modern Punjabi Literature
PUNJ 403.description: Popular and literary works in modern Punjabi, with a focus on short stories and poetry. Emphasis on reading, writing, and vocabulary development. Recommended pre-requisite: PUNJ 300.

PUNJ 404.title: The Punjabi Novel (Advanced Punjabi)
PUNJ 404.description: Study of the modern Punjabi novel to deepen understanding and use of Punjabi, and strengthen analysis in English and Punjabi. Recommended pre-requisite: PUNJ 300.

PUNJ 457.title: Punjabi Theatre
PUNJ 457.description: Punjabi-language theatre, with emphasis on Canadian forms. Reading, writing, and performance of plays; examination of history of Punjabi theatre. Recommended pre-requisite: PUNJ 300.

PUNJ 475.title: Oral Histories in Punjabi
PUNJ 475.description: Develops students' oral expression and listening comprehension in Punjabi through Community Based Learning. Students engage in oral history collection in the Punjabi-speaking community and develop short video or sound projects. Analytical reading and writing required. Recommended pre-requisite: PUNJ 300.
